snippet.title: Announcing: All Army Attack - Let the Auto-Battles Begin!
snippet.description:
Devolver Digital's first AAA game has been announced! 
Wishlist now, demo soon: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4128840/All_Army_Attack/

All Army Attack is a chaotic large-scale roguelike auto-battler that unites animals and plants against a formidable cosmic threat! 

To celebrate the reveal, All Army Attack will deploy an exclusive demo during Steam Auto-Battler Fest, running from November 16-23!

All Army Attack releases in 2027.

Join the Official All Army Attack Discord: https://discord.gg/MeEamSbPdu

Visit our website for more info: https://www.devolverdigital.com/

Subscribe for more: https://devolver.link/youtube
